title: Lucia Stole His Coat Instead
hook: The Fixer paid them in newspaper. Jason swore. Lucia thanked him, then lifted his coat from the chair.
script: The Fixer paid them in newspaper. Jason swore. Lucia thanked him, then lifted his coat from the chair. He answered his phone. They left before he noticed his missing jacket. In its pocket, she found the valet ticket. Jason remembered the steel payment case beneath the Fixer's car seat. Downstairs, the garage kiosk swallowed the ticket and released a key pouch. His coupe unlocked. Jason opened the passenger door. The case was chained beneath the seat. Lucia handed him the coat again. Inside its other pocket sat a brass key. The Fixer had carried his entire security system upstairs. They drove out with the case. His windscreen pass raised the barrier as he reached the garage stairs. At the next light, Lucia opened their payment. Jason offered to return the coat. She checked the weather.
